changes.comment: BREAKING: IMemoryIndex holds and returns IIndexedMemoryEntry (scope + envelope, no body) across every read; adds get(target) for O(1) keyed lookup; rebuild takes projected entries while patch keeps whole records. IMemoryStore.list now requires a selection that narrows and rejects one that does not, naming the new scanEveryRecord() opt-out; listEntries() is the free envelope-only whole-vault read. Retrievers take { index, resolver } and materialize through the new IMemoryRecordResolver. Removes the store's resident-body ceiling from the contract rather than from one implementation, and drops the open path's peak body residency from N records to one. IMemoryStore additionally extends IMemoryRecordResolver and gains a required listEntries(), so any implementation or test double of it must be widened. The @public free functions indexedRecordMatchesQuery and selectByQuery take entries now, and selectByQuery returns them.
